text:
sophia: FYI I'm about to merge the terraform module refactor that hoists provider blocks to the root and standardizes inputs. tagging the infra crew for quick 👀

alex: pinged. what's the rollout plan? any immediate terraform state moves?

sophia: no state moves. it's purely module/registry layout + provider_block extraction. but it does change the module input for k8s secret name (module -> k8s.name). quick check please on consumers.

maria: will any modules start requiring a different provider source/version?

sophia: root now pins providers in root providers.tf: `provider "kubernetes" {}` kept minimal. versions are in `required_providers` with exact minor pins e.g. `kubernetes = "~> 2.20"` — nothing major.

alex: okay. can we avoid forcing everyone to re-run `terraform init -upgrade`? last time lockfile churned a ton.

jordan: if the root required_providers changes, modules may get lockfile diffs. suggest we run `terraform init` in a temp workspace and commit `terraform.lock.hcl` from root.

sophia: planned that. I'll generate a canonical lockfile and put it in the repo root. I want to confirm CI expectations: should every service repo accept the root lockfile or keep their own?

maria: services should inherit root lockfile where possible. but some legacy repos pin providers separately — we should list exceptions.

alex: also note: some repos use terraform 1.4 CLI, lockfile format slight diffs vs 1.5. Are we standardizing CLI version?

ops-oncall: we decided on 1.5.6 in infra-standards doc. CI runs `tfenv` to that version.

sophia: thanks. I'll add a pre-merge comment with a plan: 1) add root terraform.lock.hcl (from 1.5.6), 2) update module input docs for k8s secret name, 3) run `make tf-validate` in CI to detect consumer breakage.

alex: quick question — secret wiring: module used to accept `secret_name` string, new module expects `metadata = { name = var.name }`. Will modules still accept `secret_name`?

sophia: I've added a compatibility var: `secret_name = null` and logic: ```hcl
locals { effective_name = var.secret_name != null ? var.secret_name : var.metadata.name }
resource "kubernetes_secret" "this" { metadata { name = local.effective_name } ... }
```

jordan: nice. cover edge cases where consumers pass both. add a validate block to error if both provided differently.

sophia: good call. I'll add `validation { condition = var.secret_name == null || var.secret_name == var.metadata.name ... }`.

deploy-bot: plan for refactor branch `tf/hoist-providers` succeeded with 4 modules changed, no state changes. plan summary: +0/-0 resources.

maria: can you post the `git diff` for providers.tf? want to check exact version pins before I approve.

sophia: posted in PR. short snippet: ```hcl
terraform { required_providers { kubernetes = { source = "hashicorp/kubernetes" version = "~> 2.20" } aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 4.65" } } }
```

alex: LGTM for versions. approved assuming lockfile committed. :thumbsup:

jordan: one more: update the CHANGELOG in modules folder mentioning compatibility shim for `secret_name`.

sophia: will do. merging in ~30m unless anyone objects. ping me if your repo fails CI after merge and I'll help revert the lockfile change per-repo.

ops-oncall: noted — I'll watch infra-alerts channel and have rollback steps ready. :eyes:
